what: 51 Luau scripts (14 public open-source modules and 37 scripts from real games), decompiled by Tovek V2.5.1, Tovek V2.6 and luacid (luacid.dev outputs saved with each sample).

metrics.calls: helper calls rebuilt (Tovek: --stats-json when the binary has it, else printed call-site comments; luacid: its own "N call sites recovered" banner)
metrics.lines: non-blank output lines (luacid banner lines left out); lower is shorter
metrics.gen_share: share of declared names that are generated (v1, p2, var3, ...); lower is better
metrics.name_recall: 14 public samples (Fusion_Types left out): share of the source's declared names the output also declares
metrics.token_sim: same 13 samples: token-sequence similarity to the original source (difflib ratio, mean)
metrics.census_recall: Tovek only: inlined copies of named helpers found from -g1 line info that came back as calls
